fields.rationale: States cluster by how far their drug authority extends: some limit dietitians to delegated dose adjustments only, some add independent supplement prescribing, and one frames authority as protocol-based legend drug prescribing.

assignments.raw_value: May implement prescription drug dose adjustments for specific disease treatment protocols under approved protocols and prescriber delegation; shall not prescribe or initiate drug treatment except as provided.

A licensed dietitian or licensed nutritionist may implement a protocol that does not reference a specific patient and results in a prescription of a legend drug that has been predetermined and delegated by a licensed practitioner.

May implement prescription drug dose adjustments for specific disease treatment protocols within facility-approved protocols and as delegated by licensed prescriber; may prescribe or discontinue vitamin and mineral supplements.

May implement prescription drug dose adjustments for specific disease treatment protocols within facility-approved protocols as approved and delegated by the licensed prescriber; may recommend and order or discontinue vitamin and mineral supplements. Cannot independently prescribe or initiate drug treatment.
